page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Catchword at lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ligit legem nostram, Josephum Scalige-rum, Christianum Francum, Dominus conservet eum, & ornet eum in illis, quæ in bonum recordetur. Amen, Litera tua allata est ad nos, quæ quæstiones continebat: mittimus ad te, quod nobis occurrit super eas ex lege & consvetudi-ne, & Rabino Synagogæ nostræ, Synago-gæ Mosis Filii Amram, quæ credit Domi-no & Mosi Prophetæ Filio Amram & le-gi Sanctæ & monti Garizim domui Dei; lex autem nostra quinq; est librorū: con-tingit præterea & celebratur quotannis Pascha in monte Garizim permanq; Sacer-dotis magni, Eleazari Filii Phinees,, dese-mine Phinees Filii Aaronis Sacerdotis deci-ma quarta die mensis primi. Postea faci-mus festū Septimanarū, ipsum autē obsi-gnatio est & sigillū numeri quinquaginta dierū, & Sabbatum Amalekitarum, & non Congregationis & dies lectionis; faci-mus quoqve festum Tabernaculorum mense septimo die decimo quinto, & ite-rum octavo; dies vero expiationis die decimo ejusdem mensis, tum diebus de-

page.notes: The first word "ligit" is clipped at the left edge of the scan, so the first letter may be lost; the fragment is kept as it stands. "consvetudi-" is printed with v (consvetudine) and is left as printed. "Phinees,," shows a doubled comma or ditto mark after the name; it is copied as printed. The final word "decem" is split: "de-" is at the line end and "cem" is the catchword. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
